segments.normalizedSource: ```swift func dropInteraction(_ interaction: UIDropInteraction, sessionDidUpdate session: UIDropSession) -> UIDropProposal { let dropLocation = session.location(in: view) updateLayers(forDropLocation: dropLocation) let operation: UIDropOperation if imageView.frame.contains(dropLocation) { /* If you add in-app drag-and-drop support for the .move operation, you must write code to coordinate between the drag interaction delegate and the drop interaction delegate. */ operation = session.localDragSession == nil ? .copy : .move } else { // Do not allow dropping outside of the image view. operation = .cancel } return UIDropProposal(operation: operation) } ```

[UIImage] /* If you do not employ the loadObjects(ofClass:completion:) convenience method of the UIDropSession class, which automatically employs the main thread, explicitly dispatch UI work to the main thread.
